current.title: Today: mixed ring boundaries
current.subtitle: Responsibilities mapped to rings. Repeated package names show mixed responsibilities.

rings.name: Indirect userspace
rings.description: Clients that use product interfaces, not core libraries directly.

rings.name: Applications and infrastructure
rings.description: Direct core consumers; some application code is still inside library packages.

rings.name: Library responsibilities
rings.description: Useful libraries exist, but their package boundaries include applications and utilities.

rings.name: Mathematical and computational foundations
rings.description: The canonical foundation and the legacy implementation still coexist.

current.direct_note: Layer arrows are a reading guide, not mandatory routes. Penglai calls R0 directly.

separate.title: Separate Song track
lines: Song shares the canonical mathematics and uses its pinned gen1 compiler.
Whispering Tides currently uses gen1 Song interfaces.

current.external_note: OS, third-party libraries and GPU drivers are external boundaries, not extra framework rings.

proposed.title: Tomorrow: one foundation, peer libraries
proposed.subtitle: Each band has one responsibility. Peers share a ring; they are not a dependency chain.

rings.name: Indirect userspace
rings.description: Uses R2 product APIs. A direct core consumer belongs in R2 instead.

rings.name: Applications and infrastructure
rings.description: May use R1 libraries or call R0 primitives directly.

rings.name: Peer core libraries
rings.description: Each uses R0 where needed. Bedrock is for effects, not a gateway to the other peers.

rings.name: One mathematical and computational foundation
rings.description: One Apeiron repository. No dependency on R1 or applications.

cards.title: Apeiron + Sanguine
cards.summary: Apeiron + Sanguine: canonical mathematics + Rust primitives

proposed.direct_note: R2 may call R0 directly. I/O adapters stay with their library; peer dependencies remain explicit.

separate.title: Separate Song track
lines: Song shares R0 mathematics; it remains its own OS / language / prover stack.
Whispering Tides uses Song. It is not another Rust core library.

proposed.external_note: Rings describe dependencies. Support commitments and proof status are specified separately in the RFC.
